resources.string: Check your internet connection and try again.
Chat-only Instagram. Direct messages without Reels, Explore, Feed or Stories.

• Your Instagram password is never seen or stored — you sign in on Instagram's own secure page.
• Session cookies are kept in an encrypted local browser profile.
• The app only loads the Direct Messaging experience; navigation to any other part of Instagram is blocked.
• No analytics, no advertising SDKs, no data collection.
Log out and delete all locally stored Instagram data?\n\nThis removes the session cookies, cached files and site data from this device. You will need to log in again next time.
